about_the_game:
Live, Grow, and Adventure with Your Favorite VTubers!

VTuber Adventure Village is a multiplayer online casual adventure game that combines virtual streamer interaction with role-playing elements.

Designed for both VTubers and their fans, the game seamlessly blends life simulation, resource gathering, village building, and community interaction.

In this world, every village is led by a unique VTuber.

They are not fictional NPCs, but real creators and streamers you already know and support—joining you in daily life, adventures, and interactions within the village.

As an “Adventurer,” you will enter the dedicated server of your favorite VTuber,

gather resources, contribute to village growth, and take part in building a thriving community together with other players.

Through special quests and mini-games, you can create memorable interactions with the VTubers themselves.

In VTuber Adventure Village

Each server is a world shaped by the unique style of its VTuber.

Each journey is a story co-written with the village leader.

This is a brand-new adventure that connects VTubers, players, and communities.

Here, the game is not just about playing—it’s about growing, sharing, and experiencing together.

Key Features

Varied Activities: Mine rare resources, go fishing, and hunt wild creatures.

Character Customization: Collect items to unlock outfits and create your own unique style.

Expanding Content: Ongoing updates bring new challenges and more appearance options.

Community Interaction: Join VTuber-led events, contribute to village development, and complete community missions.

Relaxed Companion Experience: Strengthen the bond between VTubers and fans in a shared game world.

short_description: VtuberStory is a multiplayer casual game where you step into a VTuber’s unique world as an adventurer. Collect resources through mining, fishing, and hunting, then trade them for outfits to customize your look. Explore, build, and connect with VTubers and fellow fans in a vibrant virtual village!
